appearance.summary: A quick-moving, athletic woman with an approachable smile and the practical look of someone ready to head straight into the field.
appearance.build: Athletic build from regular running and weekend rec-league sports
appearance.hair: Chestnut-brown hair usually tied back in a low ponytail or clipped up when concentrating
appearance.eyes: Hazel eyes that stay expressive even when she is trying to sound brisk
appearance.clothing: Blue overshirt over a plain T-shirt, dark jeans, running shoes, and a watch she checks constantly without seeming rude
distinguishing_features: A faint scar near her left eyebrow from a teenage basketball injury
Usually carries a bright reusable water bottle covered in transit and park stickers

personality.summary: Energetic, warm, and practical, with a talent for turning confusion into forward motion.
personality.temperament: Generally upbeat and resilient; impatience shows when people avoid simple decisions or let preventable bottlenecks linger.
personality.social_style: Easy to approach, comfortable with new people, and often the first to translate between specialists who are talking past each other.
personality.speech_style: Friendly, concrete, and fast-moving; asks pointed follow-up questions and often summarizes the practical next step out loud.
strengths: spots coordination gaps before they become crises
keeps track of people, timelines, and loose ends at the same time
brings momentum to groups that are stuck in abstraction
stays personable while delivering unwelcome but necessary clarity
flaws: can sound sharper than she intends when she is frustrated
sometimes overcommits because she hates letting a task stall
has trouble trusting slow deliberation when a visible action seems available

background.residence: A shared townhouse with two close friends near a busy commercial street
background.education: Bachelor's degree in industrial engineering with a certificate in project coordination
background.history: Jordan grew up helping in her family's small restaurant, where she learned to notice timing, handoffs, and what happens when one missing item slows everyone else down. After university she worked in logistics support and then operations analysis, building a reputation for translating messy, cross-functional work into systems people can actually follow.

fears: avoidable chaos caused by poor coordination
letting irritation make her unfair to slower thinkers
watching someone carry too much alone because nobody checked in early
needs: visible plans and clear update rhythms
regular movement during long desk-heavy days
short social check-ins that keep work feeling human

limitations: gets restless in purely theoretical discussions with no stated decision
less comfortable with deep technical implementation details than with systems and people flow
can miss her own fatigue until it shows up as impatience

likes: walking a problem through out loud with someone she trusts
dislikes: people treating support work as invisible
habits: color-codes her notes so actions and risks stand out immediately
arrives early enough to scan a room before a meeting starts
checks whether quieter teammates have actually had space to speak
routines: starts the day by scanning upcoming deadlines and likely bottlenecks
takes a brisk walk or stair loop when concentration dips
winds down in the evening with a quick call to family or friends

relationships.relationship: Trusted colleague and frequent problem-solving partner
relationships.notes: Jordan appreciates Alex's rigor and often makes space for him to think, even while nudging him away from over-analysis.
Jordan checks on Micah often and has a longstanding habit of translating complicated paperwork or logistics for him.
Tessa is one of the few people who can reliably tell Jordan when she is taking responsibility for too many moving parts.

fields.label: Worldview
fields.value: Most problems become kinder and more solvable when people name reality early, share burdens openly, and respect the invisible labor that keeps a system working.

fields.label: Community attachments
value: family group chats and practical favors
friends who gather around food more often than formal plans
